stem: After increasing phosphorus, tissue phosphorus rises but yield does not improve and another nutrient trend worsens. Which interpretation is strongest?
choices: More phosphorus should be added until yield rises
Nutrient interactions and luxury accumulation should be considered before further increases
The tissue result proves phosphorus deficiency
rationale: Cannabis nutrition responses are interactive and more input does not automatically improve performance. Accumulation without benefit can indicate excess or imbalance under the tested conditions.
